Consequently `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` remains float32 in the output, violating the Objective/Required result and making the required check "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" fail (the plan itself even asserts 48, contradicting the spec). The negative-lookahead float32 assertion is also inconsistent with the true 64-tensor set since it excludes only the 48-tensor pattern, so `attention.dense.weight` is checked as float32 (correct dtype but for the wrong reason — it should have been cast to bf16 and wasn't).
